verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships as a distributable skill set through a dedicated marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`), the Claude plugin directory, an Antigravity Marketplace manifest, and `devin plugins install`. A hands-on probe also copied a skill as plain markdown into a project's `./.claude/skills/` folder, where it can be committed for the whole team. Skills in `skills/` are the single source of truth shared verbatim across harnesses. missing for 10: team or org-level rollout and version-pinning guidance, a single install that covers every harness (each harness needs its own install), first-party docs on committing skills to a project repo (the probe used the third-party `npx skills` installer), and independent team-usage corroboration.
